damage.stage: PC1192..1233 after B181/B140 before q032; no attack-bit/life/distance check added

order: physical scepter gate, grant/revoke virtual via actual source Has_A_Item

a111.retarget: Help rejection and existing-target rejection before old source link end

a112.activeSourceGate: matching current-type Buff level==1 and source found in Tower_ALL
a112.selection: retract old; target effective STR strictly highest =>1; else AGI>INT with STR<=AGI =>2; else3

raw.rounding: frac(source effective selected stat/100)>.5 and Count<30 then Count+=1
raw.refresh: old selected source stat raw floor differs from Level; if new>=30 and old29 suppress refresh; target highest or rounding-only change alone not refresh

endlessMultiplier.authority: Q61 exact tooltip +50%; original source uses 100/67

selected.refresh: same selected-type source grade differs from saved grade => retract then reselect and rate; capped43 stable; current target highest alone does not refresh
selected.rollback: saved actualAmount; base INT setter sequence preserved, STR/AGI native contributions removed from T121/T122
selected.forcedLevelZero: same linear expression returns.1; not reinterpreted as learned level1
selected.activity: original Count>24 gate, task2 parameter actualAmount

toggle.authority: Q24, custom AEim not matched client

bufferMana.source: missing DataC, base AEim10 not inherited as fact

damage.source: missing DataA, base immolation damage not inherited as fact

toggle.drainRate: read current actual logical slot level at each native tick; existing regeneration settles first
toggle.exhaustion: consume remaining to0 and close when beforeMana<=rate
toggle.off: free, allowed during cooldown; remove active Buff/drain timer only; no direct A112_end or fake effect event
toggle.study: any B113/B142/B143>0 => issue off then on; restart may fail; no free fee/cooldown bypass
toggle.deathRemoveDisableDispel: close active native instance; existing scripted grant remains until A111 tick/end
toggle.sameEntityAneg: preserve native active instance, cooldown and due time; logical slot rebinds, old installed BuffID remains until real off/on

a112.manaNoLink: no source link-target guard; ordinary Tower_ALL source can toggle without connection; source action warns only if source absent from Tower_ALL

a113.terrainGate: inside committed SPELL_EFFECT; IsTerrainPathable(BUILDABILITY) true => message+return, no refund
a113.location: source caches location handle; selected Web captures coordinate value at effect
a113.callbackTarget: current A111_113_tar at expiry, not captured original
clearOrder: arrival visual at actual current source position
a113.overwrittenTimer: old timer preserved; IsInTable may return-1; follow actual sentinel table state, no private caster fallback
a113.linkEnd: not immediate; next original link tick checks distance

A111_A113.commit: recheck current valid level/resource, mark committed, spend/start cooldown, synchronous original effect entry; post-commit source rejection no rollback
